root.proposition: During the Mythos 5 cyber-evaluation, Claude's effective operating boundary remained consistent with the declared simulation / no-live-internet / no-real-consequence boundary.

subclaims.proposition: Anthropic declared the operative boundary to be a simulation with no live internet access.
No connection to the live public internet occurred during the evaluation.
No real-world external consequence occurred during the evaluation.

root.proposition: The model's internal operative disposition during the Mythos 5 evaluation is identifiable from the public package as a belief that the environment was simulated.

subclaims.proposition: Anthropic reports that the recorded chain-of-thought repeatedly represented the environment as simulated.
Those reported representations identify the model's actual internal belief that the environment was simulated.
subclaims.unresolved_conditions: no observation in the package identifies an internal epistemic state; a reported representation and the external actions are each consistent with more than one internal state.

root.proposition: The released public package is a complete and materially sufficient basis for reconstructing the foregoing propositions.

subclaims.proposition: The released record is complete and unredacted.
The released record is materially sufficient to reconstruct every relevant proposition (nothing absent is material).
subclaims.unresolved_conditions: the available observations do not establish that the material absent from the released record is immaterial to every relevant proposition.
